finalText:
**Build's clean now.** Exit 0, 8 warnings, 0 errors.

Two real bugs from the bump, not noise, both in the link stage:

- [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) read `options.retries`, but the new bundler hands `retryCount`. Fixed to read `retryCount`.
- [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) threw when `backoffEnabled` was `undefined`. New config loader leaves unset flags undefined instead of `false`. Now treats undefined as disabled, same as `false`.

Remaining 8 warnings are deprecation/lint noise (`DEP0142`, `DEP0198`, unused export, circular import, etc), not build-breaking.

Next: nothing.
